args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $flutterSdk = mise where flutter; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $flutterSdk = $flutterSdk.Trim(); $dartSdk = Join-Path $flutterSdk 'bin/cache/dart-sdk'; $env:DART_DATA_HOME = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.dart_tool/dart-data'; & (Join-Path $dartSdk 'bin/dart.exe') mcp-server --dart-sdk $dartSdk --flutter-sdk $flutterSdk --enable cli,flutter_app_lifecycle; exit $LASTEXITCODE
